summary: Iteration 18 - Email OTP Authentication System Testing. All 19 backend tests passed (100%). All frontend pages load correctly. New email-based auth flow verified: Email input first (not phone), Email OTP for signup (FREE), Password login after registration, SMS OTP only for password reset.
test_type: Email OTP Authentication System - New auth flow testing

Send Email OTP button visible in auth modal
'No SMS cost!' message visible in auth modal

Evara page loads with Pregnancy, Menopause, Community content

email_otp_signup.details: Auth modal now shows EMAIL input first (not phone). Email OTP sent via Resend API (FREE - no SMS cost). Endpoint: POST /api/auth/email-otp/send returns success with method='email'.

password_login.details: After email verification, users can login with email/password. Endpoint: POST /api/auth/login accepts email and password.

sms_otp_password_reset.details: SMS OTP only used for password reset. Endpoint: POST /api/auth/forgot-password/send-otp sends SMS via Twilio.

no_whatsapp_redirects.details: All booking flows (DiaGyn, Proton, Pharmacy) use OTP verification. No WhatsApp redirect in API responses. SMS notifications sent to staff instead.

email_notifications.details: Email notifications configured via Resend API for order updates. SENDER_EMAIL: Nevika Cura <noreply@nevikacura.com>

homepage.details: 5 service cards displayed: DiaGyn, Proton Diagnostics, Orange Pharmacy, Evara, Glydex. QR code in footer.

admin_portal.details: Admin login with password 'nevikacura2026'. Dashboard shows 4,266 medicines, 72 users, 21 appointments, 14 diagnostics, 30 pharmacy orders.

staff_portal.details: Staff login with doc_neha/Nevika@2026D. Dashboard shows Dr. Neha Patel's appointments at Pushpa Clinic.

evara_page.details: Evara Women's Wellness page loads with all programs: Pregnancy Education, Menopause Care, Women's Health Community, Period Tracker, PMS Guide, PCOS Guide.

glydex_page.details: Glydex Diabetes Care Portal shows 'Login Required' for unauthenticated users. Share report feature requires authentication.

fee_codes.details: Fee codes N1 (No fees) and E1 (Emergency) accepted in appointment booking API.
